narrative.headline: 2019 Subaru Outback: electrical and visibility issues lead owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 1,026 complaints with NHTSA. Two areas dominate: electrical system problems (361 reports, 35%) and visibility/wiper issues (326 reports, 32%) make up roughly two-thirds of all complaints. These are mostly nuisance and reliability headaches rather than safety events. The smaller categories matter more for risk: the forward collision avoidance system drew 36 reports tied to 8 crashes and 6 injuries, and engine complaints (39 reports) include 4 crashes, 1 injury, and 1 fire. Watch the driver-assist and engine items closely even though they are fewer in number.
